steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the washer or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power before servicing the unit.

steps.title: Valve harnesses
steps.body: Check VALVE HOT, INLET, PRE, and BLEACH solenoids at MAIN PWB.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Check VALVE HOT, INLET, PRE, and BLEACH solenoids at MAIN PWB.

steps.title: Replace inlet valve
steps.oemOutcome: Replace failed solenoid or valve assembly.
